notes: the report opens «وَ سَأَلَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ» with no chain: the asker is not a link (rule 5) because the report is the answer of موسى بن جعفر; he is written as imam_in_text as the one who speaks the answer; the answer quotes «أبو جعفر» (the Imam's father) as «إِنَّ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ»: whether that quoted Imam is an additional last link, with Musa as a transmitter, cannot be settled from the text, so it is not added; «العبد الصالح» and «عليهما السلام» are epithets
